solo.label: Solo
solo.pitch: Setâr and voice — intimate, minimal, meditative. Mani performs alone with his setâr, weaving Persian classical modal improvisation with original compositions.

summary: PA: stereo mains, no backline required

spec.detail: Stereo mains with adequate coverage for venue
2 channels: contact mic (XLR), vocal mic (XLR, SM58 or equivalent)
1 × active DI (if contact mic is unbalanced)

trio.label: Trio
trio.pitch: Setâr, kamanche, and percussion — the core acoustic trio, drawing on the Radif tradition and original compositions that move between Iranian classical, folk, and contemporary improvisation.

spec.detail: 5 channels: setâr contact mic, kamanche contact mic, 2 × hand-drum mics, vocal mic

band.label: Full band
band.pitch: Setâr, fretless guitar, bass, and drums — the full electric band, performing material from the debut LP Royâ-ye Mahtâb. Ranges from delicate acoustic passages to psych-rock and electronica.

summary: PA: stereo mains + subwoofer, front-fill recommended
Monitors: 4 × floor wedges or IEM system

spec.detail: Stereo mains with subwoofer; front-fill strongly recommended
14 channels: setâr (contact + DI), fretless guitar (DI), bass (DI), kick, snare top/bottom, hi-hat, 3 × toms, overheads L/R, vocal mic
4 × floor wedges or IEM system with 4 mixes
5-piece kit: 22” kick, 12”/14” rack toms, 16” floor tom, snare, hi-hat stand, 2 × crash, 1 × ride
Bass amp head + 4×10 or 8×10 cab (Ampeg or equivalent)
